about_billing_abstraction: Each work keeps its product, script, talent, language, market, and generated media together.
about_capabilities_in_code: Product facts come from the material you supply. The brief steers the creative; it never overrides what the source says.
about_code_conventions: A link that cannot be read, a conflicting spec, or a failed render stops at the exact step that needs attention.
about_dashboard_settings_admin_areas_use: Every clip is 15 seconds with selectable portrait or landscape framing and resolution, plus a complete opening, product display, and close.
about_marketing_pages_blog_content_legal: Analysis, scripting, rendering, retries, and regenerations are recorded separately, so cost per delivered clip can be reconciled.
about_mission: How the platform is built: recorded product facts, visible checkpoints, traceable versions, and failures contained to the step they belong to.
about_production_line_description: VibeSKU Clips turns product material into short-form video the way a production line does: one intake, one set of rules, and a record of what was made from what.
about_project_shaped_builders_who_need_m: One guided work turns one product into one clip. Every retry and regeneration stays traceable to the choice that created it.
about_scope_boundary: The platform produces a downloadable video. Account login, posting, product tagging, and performance stay with your operations team.
about_scoped_improvements: Edits, localisations, and regenerations are saved as new versions. The finished clip can always be traced to the exact script it came from.
about_services_behind_config: Generated talent references and product material stay attached to the work that used them.

ugc_product_revision_images_full: This product already has 8 images. Remove an unneeded image under Edit material first.
ugc_product_source_url_hint: Where the product facts are read from.
ugc_products_description: Product facts drive every script. Add a link, images, and a brief.
ugc_script_edit_description: Edits are saved as a new version. The original stays as it is.
ugc_script_lock_hint: A locked script is never rewritten. If the voiceover runs long, you are asked to trim it.
ugc_script_production_prompt_hint: The scene, talent, product, lighting, performance, realism, physics, sound, and continuity constraints live here.
ugc_scripts_description: Every script keeps its own version, including localised and edited copies.
ugc_scripts_empty_hint: Scripts appear here after you confirm them in a work.
ugc_talent_appearance_placeholder: For example: a woman in her twenties with long light-brown hair and caramel highlights, white linen shirt; slightly low-angle iPhone selfie on a Mediterranean terrace in warm afternoon light with a softly blurred background…
ugc_talent_empty_hint: Describe the person and photo treatment to generate a reusable talent reference image.
ugc_talent_form_description: Provide the person and photography direction. A reference image is optional. The system expands it into a complete image prompt, then generates the final talent image.
ugc_talent_generated_hint: Include facial structure, complexion, features, hair, full outfit, accessories, pose, setting, light, camera angle, expression, and anything to avoid.
ugc_talent_generation_failed: The image could not be generated.
ugc_talents_description: Generate and manage talent reference images that keep the same performer consistent through a clip.
ugc_template_scenario_description: Opens on a problem, then the product resolves it in a real setting.
ugc_template_spokesperson_description: Someone talks to camera and shows the product.
ugc_template_tutorial_description: Short numbered steps with the product in hand.
ugc_video_mode_one_take_hint: Skip storyboard generation. The model receives the approved script, talent image, and product images directly.
ugc_video_mode_storyboard_hint: Generate and review one key frame per beat before rendering the video.
ugc_work_beats_hint: How the 15 seconds are spent. The storyboard draws one key frame per beat.
ugc_work_beats_one_take_hint: How the 15 seconds are spent within one continuous shot.
ugc_work_delete_hint: This work and its generated clip will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
ugc_work_detail_description: Follow the selected production steps and confirm each result before the next cost is incurred.
ugc_work_done_hint: The finished clip is ready to preview or download here and in Works.
ugc_work_failure_incomplete: Something this step needed is missing. Go back a step and check the setup.
ugc_work_failure_no_script: There is no script to work from. Go back and write one.
ugc_work_failure_render: The video model refused this render. Try adjusting the script, references, or format.
ugc_work_failure_prism_auth: The Prism credentials do not match this environment. Check PRISM_API_BASE_URL, PRISM_API_KEY, and PRISM_API_SECRET.
ugc_work_failure_prism_config: Prism is not configured. Add its API URL and credentials, then retry.
ugc_work_failure_prism_request: Prism rejected this request. Check the selected model and generation parameters.
ugc_work_failure_prism_response: Prism returned an unrecognized result. Check the service version, then retry.
ugc_work_failure_prism_unavailable: Prism is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
ugc_work_failure_storage: Storage is not configured, so nothing generated could be kept.
ugc_work_failure_terminated: The step ended before it finished. Run it again.
ugc_work_failure_timeout: The provider took too long. Running it again usually clears it.
ugc_work_frame_edit_hint: Describe the shot the way you want to see it. Only this frame is redrawn.
ugc_work_frame_failed: This frame did not come back. Redraw it.
ugc_work_new_cost_hint: Only the script is written now. Optional frames and video wait for your confirmation.
ugc_work_new_description: Choose the product, talent, format, generation mode, language, and market for one clip.
ugc_work_new_hint: Pick what it sells and who presents it. The script is written from these answers as soon as you start.
ugc_work_new_product_hint: The product is read first. You see what came back before anything is written from it.
ugc_work_random_talent_hint: A fictional adult creator will be generated for this work and saved to your talent library.
ugc_work_product_hint: Check what the system read from the product. Everything after this is written from it.
ugc_work_product_needs_input: This product needs more material before anything can be written from it.
ugc_work_script_hint: The storyboard and video follow this production prompt and beat-by-beat dialogue. Edit anything that is not accurate.
ugc_work_script_one_take_hint: The video follows this production prompt and beat-by-beat dialogue in one continuous shot. Edit anything that is not accurate.
ugc_work_script_wait: The model is reading the product and writing fifteen seconds of it. Usually under a minute.
ugc_work_stalled_hint: The step was queued but no worker took it. Start the worker process and it will resume on its own.
ugc_work_step_failed_unknown: No reason was recorded. Running it again is safe.
ugc_work_storyboard_hint: One key frame per beat. Open a frame to reword it and draw it again — this is the last cheap change.
ugc_work_storyboard_wait: One image per beat, all drawn at once. A minute or two.
ugc_work_video_one_take_wait: The approved script, product images, and talent image go directly to the video model. Give it a few minutes.
ugc_work_video_wait: The key frames, the product and the talent go to the video model together. This is the slow step, so give it a few minutes.
ugc_works_description: See every work from product reading through the finished clip, and continue wherever attention is needed.
ugc_works_empty_hint: Create a work to see its progress here from the first step onward.

uploads_file_could_not_prepared_upload: The file could not be prepared for upload.

uploads_file_upload_failed_before_comple: The file upload failed before completion.
uploads_full_matrix_when_needed: Use the full supported matrix when a workflow needs several files in one run.
uploads_gallery_style_compression: Best for gallery-style uploads with image compression and instant preview tiles.
uploads_lane_for_inspection: Use this lane when your application must inspect or transform files on the server before they reach object storage.
uploads_looser_preset_demo: Demonstrates a looser preset without changing the application-wide safety checks.
uploads_narrower_single_file_preset: Shows a narrower preset for single-file document collection and validation feedback.
uploads_network_connection_dropped: The network connection dropped during upload.
uploads_one_files_larger_than_allowed_li: One of the files is larger than the allowed limit.
uploads_preset_demos: Preset demos for image, document, batch, and larger file uploads.
uploads_product_page_previews: Product pages often need bespoke previews. The upload logic stays shared while the layout stays page-specific.
uploads_request_in_app_boundary: The request stays inside your application boundary before landing in storage.
uploads_route_through_backend: Route files through your backend when validation or processing must happen first.
uploads_same_upload_state_can_drive_cust: The same upload state can drive a custom image grid through render props.
uploads_server_upload_did_not_complete: The server upload did not complete.
uploads_shared_uploader_presets: Reuse the shared uploader with different presets to demonstrate the common paths most products need.
uploads_too_many_files_selected_demo: Too many files selected for this demo.
uploads_upload_canceled: The upload was canceled before it finished.
uploads_upload_could_not_completed: The upload could not be completed.
uploads_upload_request_failed: The upload request could not be completed. Please try again.
uploads_upload_request_failed_try_again: The upload request failed. Try again.
uploads_use_path_when_backend_needs_vali: Use this path when the backend needs to validate or transform files before storage.
